what: a modelled M10 thread on a d10 shaft whose root at the d16 shoulder has an r1 fillet: it reaches the fillet at every angle, the fillet whole
method: the fillet's ring: the corner square [5,6]x[10,11] less the quarter disc about (6,11), V_f = 2 pi (5.5 - pi/4 (6 - 4/(3 pi))), its centroid z from the same moments; the cylinder face starts at z=11, where the fillet meets it. the shaft's lower end (z=11) is a shoulder (the fillet and the collar lies past it, in the groove's way), so the groove runs on past its plane and is trimmed there, and every slice of the shaft above it loses the same; the top end is free, the groove runs out into the air. V = pi 8^2 10 + V_f + pi 5^2 1 + 24 (pi 5^2 - V_turn/P), V_turn one turn of the groove within the shaft (m as in 001). Tolerance 0.05%: SMLib's exact screw sweep
